body.label: Trigger
body.html: A creature you can see within weapon range makes a ranged attack while adjacent to cover or an unattended object.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Shoot the cover or object instead of the creature. On a success, the triggering creature suffers -1 Defense against that attack and your next Ballistics Action before your next turn.

surges.html: Ignore 1 Defense from cover or increase this Reaction's range by 2 units.
Ignore 1 Defense against the triggering creature if this Reaction attacks it.
